faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.q1: How do I check my League of Legends stats on ggez.gg?
faq.a1: Simply enter your summoner name and region in the search bar above. You'll instantly see your complete LoL profile including ranked stats, match history, champion mastery, win rates, and detailed performance analytics.
faq.a2: Yes! ggez.gg is completely free. Access unlimited summoner lookups, champion statistics, match analysis, and AI-powered coaching insights without any subscription or payment required.
faq.q3: What makes ggez.gg different from other LoL stats sites?
faq.a3: ggez.gg provides the fastest summoner analytics in the world. Unlike other sites that are cluttered with ads and slow to load, our platform is optimized for lightning speed, delivering real-time match data, AI coaching, and meta tier lists instantly.
faq.a4: We support all League of Legends regions including EUW, EUNE, NA, KR, BR, LAN, LAS, OCE, TR, RU, and JP. Search for any summoner across any region and get instant access to their stats and match history.
faq.q5: How does the AI coaching feature work?
faq.a5: Our AI analyzes your match data including builds, KDA, CS, vision score, and decision-making patterns. It then provides personalized coaching tips, identifies mistakes, suggests optimal builds, and gives champion-specific advice to help you improve and climb the ranked ladder.
